images.prompt: An open filing drawer photographed from above, packed tight with unlabelled hanging folders seen at a grazing angle so that nothing written on them could be visible, and they are unmarked. One conspicuous empty gap sits in the middle of the row where nothing was ever filed. Cream light rakes across the folder tops. The single red element is one red file tab. Deep dark navy dominates every surface and every background plane — never blue, never cyan, no teal anywhere. Soft cream (#F4EFE3) is the only highlight. Exactly one red element in the entire image, nothing else is red. Absolutely no text, no letterforms, no numerals, no signage, no logos, no vendor marks on any faceplate or panel. No tick-mark numerals. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork: no border, no cream margin, no white matting, no picture frame. Quiet, photographic, shallow depth of field.
images.qa: Approved, first roll. Packed drawer of unmarked folders with one conspicuous gap where nothing was filed, single red tab. The grazing-angle clause kept every folder blank.
